##### Project general facts

The Haven 2 is a contemporary residential development by Meraki Developers, designed to deliver a harmonious balance of modern architecture, everyday comfort, and sustainable living. The project features elegantly designed residences with spacious layouts, abundant natural light, and refined interiors that emphasize both functionality and timeless style. Thoughtfully planned with attention to quality and detail, The Haven 2 creates a peaceful residential environment where sophisticated design meets practical urban living.

Residents enjoy a comprehensive selection of lifestyle amenities created to promote wellness, relaxation, and community living. The development offers a modern fitness center, swimming pool, beautifully landscaped gardens, and dedicated recreational spaces, providing opportunities for both active and leisurely lifestyles. Every shared space has been carefully designed to foster a welcoming atmosphere where residents can unwind, connect, and enjoy a balanced way of life.

The residences are finished using modern, high-quality materials that reflect the project's commitment to durability and contemporary elegance. Interiors feature carefully selected finishes and functional layouts designed for maximum comfort and everyday convenience. Kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, while the residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners the freedom to personalize their living spaces according to their own style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Majan is a 1.5 million square meter district in Dubai. It is located at the heart of the large Dubailand community. Majan is a perfect place for those who are looking for a buy-to-invest property. While the community is developing, apartment prices have not yet reached their maximum values. If you want to purchase an off-plan housing unit, you can count on a good discount.

With Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road at its front, Majan lies in close proximity to Al Ain Road. These roads provide Majan strategic access to Al Ain, Sharjah and Abu Dhabi. The area comprises 100 residential complexes, six iconic towers, four hotels and mixed-use units.

The main advantage of Maijan is its proximity to high-ranked schools, business and shopping centers, medical facilities, major amusement parks, and sports facilities. While the community boasts its excellent location and good infrastructure, rental rates are not as high as in the seashore or central parts of the emirate. Affordable prices attract locals and tourists who want to rent an apartment in a good area at an affordable price.
